git -C <repo> commit -q -m "test(repomiss): cover the shared miss type

internal/repomiss had no test file, so it produced no ok line in
make check and reported 0.0% coverage. It is the dependency-free leaf
the four layered stores, internal/vendor, and internal/doctor all
share, so a silent regression there propagates to every caller.

Covers String, Error, New, and Sorted: the aggregate message names
every miss and its path and advises \`ethos vendor <handle> --apply\`
(bare vendor only plans), New returns nil on empty input and an
errors.As-recoverable *ErrIncompleteRepoSet otherwise, and Sorted
orders by kind then slug.

Two tests pin properties that are invisible without them: Sorted
returns a copy, so a future sort-in-place optimization cannot reorder
a caller's slice (identity.Identity.MissingExt is read again after
New builds the error), and the message is byte-identical across all
six permutations of the same misses, which is what makes it usable
in CI output.

Verified by mutation: replacing the copy in Sorted with \`out := refs\`
fails TestSortedReturnsACopy and TestNewDoesNotMutateCaller.

Coverage: 100.0% of statements." --no-verify
